rationale: Identity was verified correctly using full name and zip, and the agent retrieved the user’s orders before acting. However, the agent performed multiple order-changing writes (returns and a cancellation) without explicitly confirming the exact changes with the user, violating policy. More critically, the user requested canceling only the newly ordered garden hose if possible; otherwise, not to cancel anything else. The agent canceled the entire pending order (#W2575533) without confirmation, contradicting the user’s constraint. While the refund breakdown and total ($2,537.77) match the tool data, these policy breaches (unconfirmed writes and overbroad cancellation) require a fail verdict.
